svg.title: Devices and entities created by the integration
svg.desc: The Modbus interface is the parent device. Under it hang one device per indoor unit and, if a power meter was chosen, an Outdoor unit device for the outdoor unit.
svg.text: Modbus interface (parent device)
binary_sensor connectivity (available when the bus is not)
sensor bus messages, errors, frames per cycle, units present
sensor interface status, slave address, rare-event counters
button find indoor units · firmware = interface version
Indoor unit ×N (one device each)
CLIMATE
power, setpoint 17-30 °C, mode, fan, swing
attributes: check_code, check_code_description, rac_functions
CONTROLS
select power limit (Save)
switch Hi-Power, ECO, Quiet FCU, Silence CDU
switch six remote-controller locks · button reset filter
READBACK
sensor setpoint, mode, fan, louver, capacity, hours
sensor check code (decoded), model, serial number
binary_sensor power, filter, alarm, five RAC function states
no hvac_action: a RAC interface never reports the thermo bit
Outdoor unit (optional, one for the system)
FROM AN EXTERNAL POWER METER
sensor power draw
sensor energy (unit and class copied from the source)
binary_sensor running (power at or above the threshold)
model and serial typed in the setup or the options
WHY ONE METER, NOT ONE PER ROOM
a multisplit has a single outdoor unit; its supply
says that something runs, not which room asked for it
